author: Home Repair Tutor
description: LED shower niches look amazing. But they need a special switch. Schluter’s ECX switch is both the driver and dimmer. It can control multiple LED lights. I actually have four niches/lights connected to this one switch. Definitely a great way to bring more light into the shower and make it safer for older users
title: Schluter ECX Switch Tips for LED Shower Niche - #showerniche #schlutersystems #sponsored ored
